label: preparing
what: Possibly a gathering or celebration in the great hall, with lighting and bread supplies, presented to the mayor as a lighting inspection. This is an inference, not confirmed: Builder arranged the visit, many lanterns were present, Freight and Innkeeper waited there, and Baker reportedly prepared an eighty-loaf freight order and received supplies from Builder. The record does not establish that all these activities shared a purpose or that the inspection was a cover. No additional person is demonstrably a knowing helper to an undisclosed plan; Secretary knowingly arranged the stated inspection only.
